data: Which of the following methods are compared in plot 'd'?

The question asks which methods are compared in plot 'd'. From the caption, we know that plot 'd' is related to the read-write policy for SANN. In this plot, there are two lines representing different policies: one for encoding (enc) and one for decoding (dec). Therefore, the methods compared in plot 'd' are the push-pop policy for encoding and decoding.
